description.value: More Bikes is a full-service bicycle retailer located at UBC, carrying major brands including Giant, Liv, Kona, Rocky Mountain, and Brodie across road, gravel, MTB, and e-bike disciplines. The shop offers tune-ups, repairs, and maintenance alongside a broad accessories range that includes touring-specific gear. Its position near the UBC campus makes it a convenient stop for cyclists on the Vancouver Crossing Loop.

No address, phone, or explicit pump/walk-in language was recoverable from the truncated page content.
